  "title": "Disclosure of Information Outside FBI Jurisdiction",
  "setting": "An FBI field office, upon receipt of credible information, under FBI disclosure guidance.",

  "agent": "The FBI field office",
  "agent_role": "decide",
  "situation": "An FBI field office has received credible information concerning serious criminal activity outside the FBI's investigative jurisdiction. The information is at a disclosure decision point involving a law-enforcement agency or agencies with jurisdiction. The governing rule calls for prompt transmission or referral while identifying circumstances that may restrict full disclosure. It also addresses limited disclosure when feasible and full disclosure once a restriction no longer applies. The field office must determine how to handle the information under these conditions and safeguards.",
  "question": "What should the FBI field office do about transmitting or referring the information to law-enforcement agencies with jurisdiction and determining the extent and timing of disclosure?",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The FBI field office has received credible information concerning serious criminal activity.",
      "spans": ["src:8f2e864de206#p36.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The serious criminal activity is outside the FBI's investigative jurisdiction.",
      "spans": ["src:8f2e864de206#p36.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The FBI field office is generally required to promptly transmit the information or refer the complainant to a law-enforcement agency having jurisdiction.",
      "spans": ["src:8f2e864de206#p36.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Full disclosure may be restricted when it would jeopardize an ongoing investigation, endanger an individual's safety, disclose a human source's identity, interfere with a human source's cooperation, or reveal legally privileged information.",
      "spans": ["src:8f2e864de206#p36.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "When full disclosure is restricted, the field office must make at least limited disclosure to an agency or agencies with jurisdiction whenever feasible.",
      "spans": ["src:8f2e864de206#p36.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Full disclosure must be made as soon as the need for restricting disclosure is no longer present.",
      "spans": ["src:8f2e864de206#p36.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "If full disclosure has not been made to the appropriate law-enforcement agencies within 180 days, the field office must promptly notify FBI Headquarters in writing of the facts and circumstances concerning the criminal activity.",
      "spans": ["src:8f2e864de206#p36.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The FBI must make periodic reports to the Deputy Attorney General about nondisclosures and incomplete disclosures in a form suitable to protect human-source identities.",
      "spans": ["src:8f2e864de206#p36.9"]
    }
